source.bookSourceComment:
1.需要在书源登录真白萌，才能使用此书源；
2.章节获取内容失败且前面有🔒的标志，请去真白萌购买此章节；
3.真白萌有访问次数限制，一分钟内不能访问太多次，所以别下载，大概率下载不到十章就一直失败；
4.基本上你一章一章阅读不会出现第3点的问题，如果出现内容失败，自己点一下刷新内容就行了；
5.待补充；

ruleSearch.bookList:
<js>
var key = java.get('key');
var page = java.get('page');
var cookieHost = java.getCookie("https://masiro.me");

var headers = {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/138.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/138.0.0.0",
    "Referer": "https://masiro.me/admin/novels",
    "Connection": "keep-alive",
    "Cookie": cookieHost || "",
    "X-XSRF-TOKEN": getCookieValue(cookieHost, "XSRF-TOKEN")
};
java.put('searchHeaders', headers);

var url = "https://masiro.me/admin/loadMoreNovels?page=" + page + 
		"&keyword=" + encodeURIComponent(key) +
		"&_t=" + Date.now();

var response = java.get(url, headers);
var responseData = JSON.parse(response.body());

if (responseData.code !== 1) {
    java.error("请求失败: " + responseData.msg);
}

var resultList = [];
responseData.novels.forEach(function(novel) {
    var tags = [];
    novel.tags.forEach(function(tag) {
        tags.push(tag.name);
    });

    var translators = [];
    novel.translators.forEach(function(translator) {
        translators.push(translator.name);
    });

    var coverUrl = "https://masiro.me" + novel.cover_img;

    var novelItem = {
        id: novel.id,
        title: novel.title,
        brief: novel.brief,
        author: novel.author,
        cover: coverUrl,
        status: novel.status, // 0=连载中, 1=已完结
        wordCount: novel.words,
        updateTime: novel.updated_at,
        latestChapter: novel.new_up_content,
        tags: tags.join(", "),
        translators: translators.join(", "),
        readCount: novel.read_num,
        collectCount: novel.collect_nums,
        likeCount: novel.thumb_up,
        sourceUrl: novel.original
    };
    
    resultList.push(novelItem);
});

java.log(JSON.stringify(resultList));
result = resultList;
</js>

<js>
//一行个数
var nums = 4 ;
//分隔符
var separator = '::'

//标题::链接::一行个数::分类

all=[
"----------     🏷标签     ----------::::1",
"进击的巨人::进击的巨人::::a"
];

//@天天gg@酷安 下面不要动
function parse(data){
	let args=data.split(separator);
	let title = args[0],url=args[1],num=nums;
	
	//链接生成
	 let u=/^\d+/.test(url)?"https://zhidao.baidu.com/msearch/ajax/getsearchlist?word="+url+"&pn=10":url;
 try {num = args[2] }catch(e){}
 try {tag = args[3];
 u=tag=="a"?'https://zhidao.baidu.com/msearch/ajax/getsearchlist?word='+url+'&pn=10':u;

 }catch(e){}
	return [title, u, num]
	}

function FlexBox(title, url, num){
		 let obj={};
		 obj.style={},obj.title=title,obj.url=url?url:'',obj.style['layout_flexGrow']=1;
	//数值设定
	let data={1:1,2:0.4,3:0.25,4:0.2,5:0.15,7:0.1,10:0.05};
obj.style['layout_flexBasisPercent']=data[num]
		return obj
		}
result=JSON.stringify(all.map(data=>{
	let args=parse(data);
	return FlexBox.apply(null, args)
	}))
</js>

    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString(".word_read@p@text",ml);

    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);

<js>
var bes = result.match(/PHA\+[A-Za-z0-9+\/]+={0,2}/g);
//java.log(String(bes))
if (!bes) {
    var ml = java.webView(null,baseUrl,null);
    var txt = java.getString(".word_read@p@text",ml);
    java.toast("正文解密失败，转为webView动态加载。");
} else {
var result = [];
for (var i = 0; i < bes.length; i++) {
    var bsej = java.base64Decode(bes[i]);
    var txtt = String(bsej);
    result.push(txtt);
      }
	var txt = result.join('\n');
}
txt;
</js>

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js> 
var J = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var o = selector => String(J.select(selector).text()) ;
var og = selector => String(J.select('[property="og:' + selector + '"]').attr('content'));
var book = {
	name: og('novel:book_name').replace(/(全文|小说|免费阅读|最新章节).*|[(（].*[）)]/g, ''),
	author: og('novel:author'),
	kind: og('novel:category') + ',' + og('novel:status').replace(/中|已/, ''),
	latest: og('novel:latest_chapter_name').replace(/^(正文|VIP章节|最新章节)?(\s+|_)|[\(（【].*[求更谢乐发推].*/g, ''),
	intro: '　　最近更新:' + og('novel:update_time').replace(/(T|\s).*/, ' ').replace(/\//g, '-') + '\n' + og('description').replace(/.*(观看小说|简介)[:：]|各位书友.*/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, '\n'),
	cover: og('image'),
	url: og('novel:read_url'),
};
book;
</js>
